text: Beyon (Batelco Group) is 56.98% held by Bahraini state bodies its 2025 annual report classifies as "Government" shareholders: the state fund Mumtalakat (36.67%) and the Social Insurance Organization (20.31%).
short: Bahraini state bodies hold 56.98% of Beyon (Mumtalakat 36.67%, Social Insurance Organization 20.31%)

source.name: Beyon — Annual Report 2025 (Corporate Governance, Ownership Structure)
source.quote: 1. Mumtalakat Holding Company 609,840,000 36.67% Government Local 2. Amber Holding Company 332,640,000 20% Organization Foreign 3. Social Insurance Organization 337,835,705 20.31% Government Local

additionalSources.name: Mubasher — Beyon B.S.C (BEYON) company profile, ownership
additionalSources.quote: Ownership Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Co (36.67%) Amber Holding Limited (20.00%) Social Insurance Organization (10.58%)
